scanNote:
8-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (54-bet) - LEAD-IN. Butun bet OCh KO'K fonda, oltita CHIZMA KADR (A-F, katakchali).

Chap yuqorida oq katta harflar 'UNIT 8', A-kadr ustida SARIQ bo'rtma harflar 'A Brush with Danger'.

KADRLAR:
 A - dengizda gulli sariq ko'ylakli erkak (Jim) qayiqda eshkak bilan, atrofida ulkan kalmar (squid) chodirlari suvdan chiqib turibdi, orqada kitlar (dumlari suvda).
 B - ikki qism: yuqorida turistlar motorli qayiqda; pastda Jim qirg'oqda oq qayiq oldida turistlar navbatini kutib olmoqda (kulmoqda).
 C - plyajda Jim to'rt turistga (ko'zoynakli, fotoapparatli) hikoya qilib bermoqda, hammasi kulmoqda; orqada shahar binolari.
 D - Jim qayiqda turistlarni orolga sayohatga olib bormoqda; orqada orol, uylar, palmalar.
 E - ulkan to'q sariq kalmar chodirlari bilan qayiqni suvdan ko'tarmoqda, Jim qayiq ichida qo'rqib turibdi; kalmarning yashil ko'zi.
 F - Jim qayiqda yolg'iz baliq ovi tayoqchasi (qarmoq) bilan, oldida asboblar qutisi; orqada tinch orol.

CHAP USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Lead-in'.
1) 'Look at the pictures, then read the sentences and circle the correct item.'
   1 In picture A there is a squid and ... a a school of whales. b a school of dolphins.
   2 The people in picture C are ... a on the beach. b in the sea.
   3 The tourists in picture D are ... a fishing. b going on a guided tour of the island.
   4 In picture E the giant squid is lifting the boat out of the water with its ... a fingers. b tentacles.
   5 In picture F the man is holding ... a a fishing rod. b a camera.
2) 'Find the three pictures that match the sentences below.' (katakchali)
   1 He stopped at his favourite quiet spot on the other side of the island and prepared his fishing rod.
   2 When he reached the beach, he told the tourists what had happened.
   3 The team of scientists searched for the giant squid for two months ... Jim's guided tours became the most popular tourist attraction on the island.
3) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen to the story and number the pictures in the correct order.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '54'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures, then read the sentences and circle the correct item.
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlarga qarang, so'ng gaplarni o'qib to'g'ri bandni aylantiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
SURATLAR BO'YIChA.


⚠ 'A BRUSH WITH DANGER':

  = xavf bilan to'qnashuv (qisqa,
  xavfli uchrashuv).
  ⚠ 'a brush with' = ... bilan
  qisqa to'qnashuv.
  ⚠ 'a brush' odatda = cho'tka!


⚠ 'A SQUID':

  = kalmar.
  ⚠ 'a giant squid' = ulkan kalmar.
  ⚠ Ko'pligi ham 'squid'.


⚠ 'A SCHOOL OF WHALES':

  = kitlar to'dasi.
  ⚠ 'school' bu yerda = to'da (baliq,
  kit, delfin uchun)! Maktab EMAS.
  ⚠ 'a school of fish' = baliq
  to'dasi.


⚠ 'TENTACLES':

  = chodirlar (kalmar, sakkizoyoq).
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈtentəklz/.


⚠ 'A FISHING ROD':

  = qarmoq tayoqchasi.


⚠ 'A GUIDED TOUR':

  = gid bilan sayohat.
  ⚠ 'to go ON a guided tour'.

items.textEn: 1 In picture A there is a squid and ...
items.whyUz:
⚠ A-kadrda suvda KIT dumlari ko'rinadi.
⚠ 'a school of' = to'da.

items.textEn: 2 The people in picture C are ...
3 The tourists in picture D are ...
options: going on a guided tour of the island
items.answer: going on a guided tour of the island
items.whyUz:
⚠ D-kadrda Jim qayiqda turistlarga orolni
ko'rsatmoqda.

items.textEn: 4 In picture E the giant squid is lifting the boat out of the water with its ...
items.uz: E-suratda ulkan kalmar qayiqni suvdan ... bilan ko'tarmoqda.

items.textEn: 5 In picture F the man is holding ...
items.whyUz:
⚠ F-kadrda Jim qarmoq tayoqchasi bilan baliq
ovlamoqda.

exercises.instructionEn: Find the three pictures that match the sentences below.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi gaplarga mos uchta suratni toping.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh GAP - UCh SURAT.

  1 'stopped at his favourite quiet
    spot ... prepared his fishing
    rod' → F (yolg'iz baliq ovi)
  2 'When he reached the beach, he
    told the tourists what had
    happened' → C (plyajda hikoya)
  3 'The team of scientists searched
    ... Jim's guided tours became
    the most popular tourist
    attraction' → B (turistlar
    navbati)


⚠ 8-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI - GAPLARDA:

  PAST SIMPLE:
    stopped, prepared, reached,
    told, searched, became
  PAST PERFECT:
    'what HAD HAPPENED' - undan OLDIN
    bo'lgan voqea


⚠ 'A SPOT':

  = joy (kichik).
  ⚠ 'a quiet spot' = tinch joy.


⚠ 'TO REACH':

  = yetib bormoq (PREDLOGSIZ).
  ⚠ 'reach TO' - XATO.


⚠ 'TO SEARCH FOR':

  = qidirmoq.
  ⚠ 'search FOR sth' - 'for'
  predlogi.


⚠ 'A TOURIST ATTRACTION':

  = turistik diqqatga sazovor joy.
  ⚠ 'to attract' = jalb qilmoq.

pairs.left: 1 He stopped at his favourite quiet spot on the other side of the island and prepared his fishing rod.
pairs.leftUz: U orolning narigi tomonidagi sevimli tinch joyida to'xtab, qarmog'ini tayyorladi.

pairs.left: 2 When he reached the beach, he told the tourists what had happened.
pairs.leftUz: Plyajga yetib borgach, u turistlarga nima bo'lganini aytib berdi.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ C-kadr: plyajda turistlarga hikoya qilmoqda.
⚠ 'what HAD happened' - past perfect.

pairs.left: 3 The team of scientists searched for the giant squid for two months ... Jim's guided tours became the most popular tourist attraction on the island.
pairs.leftUz: Olimlar jamoasi ulkan kalmarni ikki oy qidirdi ... Jimning sayohatlari oroldagi eng mashhur turistik diqqatga sazovor joyga aylandi.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ B-kadr: turistlar navbati, Jim kulmoqda -
sayohatlar mashhur.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the story and number the pictures in the correct order.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani tinglang va suratlarni to'g'ri tartibda raqamlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ AUDIO KERAK - aniq tartib
yozuvdan. Suratlar mantiqidan
EHTIMOLIY tartib:

  1 D - Jim turistlarni orolga
      sayohatga olib boradi
  2 F - keyin yolg'iz baliq oviga
      to'xtaydi
  3 E - ulkan kalmar qayiqni
      ko'taradi
  4 A - kitlar keladi, kalmar
      qo'yib yuboradi
  5 C - plyajda turistlarga aytib
      beradi
  6 B - sayohatlar mashhur bo'lib
      ketadi

  ⚠ 55-betda hikoyaning to'liq matni
  bor - u yerda tekshiriladi.

points.en: Probable order: D → F → E → A → C → B
points.uz: Ehtimoliy tartib: D → F → E → A → C → B
points.noteUz:
⚠ Audio bilan tasdiqlang; 55-betdagi matn ham
yordam beradi.

patterns.exampleEn: In picture A there is a squid and a school of whales.
patterns.exampleUz: A-suratda kalmar va kitlar to'dasi bor.

patterns.formula: When [ega] + PAST SIMPLE, [ega] + PAST SIMPLE + what had happened.
patterns.exampleEn: When he reached the beach, he told the tourists what had happened.
patterns.exampleUz: Plyajga yetib borgach, u turistlarga nima bo'lganini aytib berdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'had happened' - PAST PERFECT: aytishdan
OLDIN bo'lgan voqea (8-unit mavzusi).
